title: fairBERTs: Erasing Sensitive Information Through Semantic and Fairness-aware Perturbations
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured bias against religious groups by swapping religiously sensitive words (e.g., 'Muslim' to 'Christian') and observing the change in the model's toxicity prediction for the same sentence.
findings: A BERT model deployed on HuggingFace showed significant religious bias; swapping 'Muslim' with 'Christian' in an otherwise identical sentence caused the predicted toxicity probability to drop fourfold, indicating an unfair association of the word 'Muslim' with toxicity.
